Not validated engineering or safety instructions. LL Road Rear Wheel. Fictional assembly demonstration for model 126, LL Road Rear Wheel, using representative product 826 (RW-R623). The scope is fitting and checking supplied components, not manufacturing purchased parts.<Location LocationID="50" SetupHours="0.15" LaborHours="1.5" MachineHours="0" LotSize="1">Work Center 50 - Subassembly. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Subassembly: receive the components, build the wheel, fit the tire and reflectors, and perform simple checks. This sequence is inferred from the BOM and historical routing.<step>Check 1 EA <material>LL Hub (Product Number HU-6280)</material> and 1 EA <material>LL Road Rim (Product Number RM-R436)</material> for visible damage; hold any questionable component.</step><step>Arrange 36 EA <material>Spokes (Product Number SK-9283)</material> and 36 EA <material>LL Nipple (Product Number NI-4127)</material> for the wheel build. Use <tool>an assumed wheel-building stand and spoke wrench</tool> to lace and adjust the wheel; the pattern is illustrative. See <diag>101261</diag>.</step><step>Spin the wheel in the stand and visually check for noticeable wobble, loose spokes and damage. Set aside the wheel if a concern remains.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>Road Tire Tube (Product Number TT-R982)</material> inside 1 EA <material>LL Road Tire (Product Number TI-R092)</material> and fit them to the wheel without pinching the tube. Follow the component guidance for inflation; check that the tire is seated evenly.</step><step>Fit 2 EA <material>Reflector (Product Number RF-9198)</material> using their available attachment features. If their placement or fit is unclear, hold the assembly rather than improvising an attachment.</step><step>Check that the wheel rotates freely, the tire remains seated and the reflectors are secure. Set aside any assembly with unresolved defects.</step></Location></root>
